execution_policy: Use existing production owners and normal runner; one active writer per source module; research exemplars are not original-building evidence.
dependency_semantics: depends_on gates final integration/acceptance artifacts; research, schema and source preparation may start earlier. It does not require globally closing an entire upstream GAP.

first_parallel_lanes.research: S04 experiment design and S06 oracle inputs

work_packages.title: Repair reproduced source and receipt defects
work_packages.environment: Offline first; Windows only for the subsequent private native-C29 replay.
required_inputs: Current baseline and the two audit reproduction scripts
Existing test_engine_r08_story, test_r08_story_second_order and test_gravity_story_basis inputs
Sealed native C29 source/scenario for post-fix impact assessment
procedure: Allow finite signed absolute elevations; retain positive height and other physical input constraints. Freeze the known story-direction denominator before numerical failure.

Distinguish unavailable wall evidence from a complete, same-state, independently qualified balance that demonstrably fails. Propagate the latter to conditional consumer eligibility while retaining diagnostic numbers.
Read variable-width numeric receipt prefixes and sort numerically; check duplicate indices and terminal-record selection. Cover 99, 100 and 101 records.
Rerun the native C29 archive through the normal runner after the correction and report whether its supported results change.
work_packages.independent_oracle: Datum translation invariance; independent +100 kN imbalance in an existing complete fixture; actual 100-record writer/reader comparison.
acceptance: Translated datum preserves theta and four expected instances. Invalid numerical input retains four unresolved instances.
Missing wall evidence preserves the authorized conditional scenario; a qualified -100 kN balance contradiction cannot produce consumer-eligible factors.
The complete reader/caller census accounts for records across the 99/100 boundary in numeric order, including web, store and CLI assumptions beyond the two probed readers.
Native replay has an explicit before/after table; no assertion that a fixture proves original-building impact.
work_packages.stop_or_branch: Do not broaden this repair into a new second-order method or rewrite the runner. A failed native replay is an accounted result requiring a scoped follow-up, not a reason to delete completed evidence.
work_packages.deliverable: Targeted regression changes, before/after probes, source hashes and one normal-runner C29 impact report.

work_packages.title: Qualify project profile, generation and required design scope
work_packages.environment: Mostly offline source reconciliation; Windows for specifically absent native facts.
required_inputs: Project-adopted standard edition and amendments
Native system, story/basement roles, mass, modifiers and analysis-case settings
Required combination/family roster and actual source-generation evidence
procedure: Create a field-level sourced/adopted/unresolved applicability matrix, including BKS/DTS/BYS and directional system parameters where relevant.
Freeze required check/combination populations independently from captured or successful rows.
Use existing recursive Linear Add expansion; classify unsupported operators and missing leaves rather than reimplement recursion.
Challenge a contradictory source generation, wrong structural role and missing required combination through real consumers.
work_packages.independent_oracle: Independent project worksheet and adopted primary clauses; controlled source-state changes; hand-expanded representative combination AST.
acceptance: Every mandatory field has provenance or an explicit unresolved reason.
Case/step/source identity survives capture, scenario and consumer stages.
Missing and failed required instances remain in the denominator.
No approval-shaped field alone enables global acceptance.
work_packages.stop_or_branch: Engineering assumptions that cannot be read from ETABS become named decisions with calculated alternatives; do not repeatedly query an API for construction intent.
work_packages.deliverable: Versioned model/profile and combination manifests consumed by the current runner, with known unresolved scope.

work_packages.title: Close the C29 full column-wall first-order balance
work_packages.environment: Windows native source lane, followed by offline integration. May start in parallel with S00.
required_inputs: Valid solved finest METHOD generation and C29G_U_F, then TN_F and TP_F
Two physical cuts: +0.00 with 32 columns and 21 walls; +4.50 with 32 columns and four walls
Independent upper-body applied loads and self weight; actual cut side, origin and axis definitions
procedure: Read current installed API/output settings; acquire exact signed case/step rows and restore selections through the existing gateway. Do not assume the historical PID is still current.
Transform point-element forces correctly to global axes, integrate the upper boundary once, and preserve every contributor identity.
First publish both cuts for U_F; then extend to all six first-order case-cuts. Compare native section cuts as a second extraction path where available.
work_packages.independent_oracle: Independent load/self-weight accounting and signed equilibrium; SectionCutAnalysis cross-checks extraction but is not an independent solver.
acceptance: Both physical contributor censuses are complete and same-state qualified.
All six case-cuts account for signed force, compression, external load and residual with existing abs=0.01 kN / rel=1e-6 isclose semantics.
Missing rows are unresolved, never zero compression.
Full free-body completion is reported separately from the unsupported wall critical-load method.
work_packages.stop_or_branch: If only Max/Min shell rows are available, resolve the setting/state issue instead of relabeling them Step 1. Do not rerun the completed 18 cases unless their solved generation is invalid or a bounded missing result requires it.
work_packages.deliverable: Six-row complete balance summary plus per-contributor lineage, sealed through the existing story consumer.

work_packages.title: Qualify C104 physical coupling and local section resultants
work_packages.environment: Construction/detail review plus Windows controlled analyses and offline integration.
required_inputs: C104/W21/W22 geometry and frame-shell connections
Two gross geometries across elevation -1.50 m
Actual longitudinal/transverse reinforcement, anchorage and construction continuity
Existing 50/25 mm matched mesh evidence
procedure: Decide and document which physical parts act as one reinforced section and which exchange forces as connected members.
Integrate common physical section resultants in a common origin, including moment transfer r cross F.
Separate mesh change, geometry change and material/EI change; study local transfer zones and both geometry regions.
Keep all 14 coupled columns visible; do not reuse isolated clear-length capacity shear where not qualified.
work_packages.independent_oracle: Independent free-body integration and a reduced analytical model only within justified kinematics; construction drawings determine reinforcement continuity.
acceptance: Actual reinforcement/connection assumptions are sourced or explicitly adopted.
Six resultants balance at defined cuts.
Local governing demand and transfer quantities meet prespecified convergence budgets; frequency/base agreement alone is insufficient.
The existing 73 standalone scope is preserved while the coupled scope is explicitly qualified or unresolved.
work_packages.stop_or_branch: Missing construction detail is a source/decision task, not a reason to run more COM getters. Do not treat every generated frame station as a physical section.
work_packages.deliverable: Physical section/connection contract for both geometries and a local-resultant convergence report.

work_packages.title: Choose and qualify the second-order method by domain
work_packages.environment: Research can start immediately; final integration uses qualified S01-S03 artifacts.
required_inputs: Source-compatible loads, geometry, stiffness, creep and support assumptions
Every member/neighbor EI/L term and actual local-axis mapping
Supplied TS500 edition and unresolved Eq.7.29 interpretation
Actual variable-N and frozen Nmax cases
procedure: Execute E09-B/C: direct matched first/second-order response and load-pattern-specific eigenbuckling with analytical limits and mode/mesh sensitivity.
Derive any scalar system-to-story Nk mapping; if unsupported, calculate a bounded direct-demand alternative through current design owners.
Source-bind every EI/L term or identify its adopted idealization.
Execute E09-D/E: separate the narrow Nmax stability statement from signed response/PMM bounds; compute discriminating length and product/max interpretations.
work_packages.independent_oracle: Analytical member/frame limits, independent reduced model where justified, converged direct response, primary-code applicability and a branch-discriminating report case.
acceptance: The chosen route names its material, cracking, creep, slenderness, axial-variation and coupling domain.
Eigenvalue times story Nd is not accepted as Nk without a demonstrated mapping.
No double application of initial P-Delta and magnification; first/second analyses share the intended basis.
All calculable candidates, their differences where comparable, and failed or unsupported scalar-mapping evidence are recorded. A qualified direct route can be reviewed without manufacturing Nk.
work_packages.stop_or_branch: A failed scalar mapping ends that hypothesis; it does not justify inventing wall Nk. Direct linear-material geometric response also must not be declared a complete nonlinear-material code method without qualification.
work_packages.deliverable: Versioned method decision and implemented consumer for its supported domain, with alternative results and remaining limitations.

work_packages.title: Resolve spectral scalar residuals and design-demand policy
work_packages.environment: Offline reconstruction; Windows only for absent full-precision modal/torsion inputs.
required_inputs: Frozen 4,824 comparison population, 4,686 matches and 138 exceptions at 34 columns
Original modal amplitudes, modes, damping, scaling and eccentricity definitions
Physical cuts and exact generation identities
procedure: Partition the 138 exceptions by mechanism and resolve one representative end to end before broad recapture.
Recompute the whole fixed population without increasing tolerances to absorb unexplained error.
Separately calculate an explicit sufficient-bound/envelope policy or compatible signed reference scenario for each design consumer.
Demonstrate coverage of any continuous PMM search; interval corners alone are not a general proof.
work_packages.independent_oracle: Independent high-precision CQC/scale arithmetic, damping/orthogonal limits and static torsion equilibrium.
acceptance: All 4,824 controls remain accounted.
Resolved precision or scaling mechanisms reproduce the relevant class.
No scalar spectrum extrema are labeled physically simultaneous.
Design-bound success, bound failure, physical failure and unresolved applicability have distinct meanings.
work_packages.stop_or_branch: Do not search for a unique simultaneous N-M-V state in Max/Min spectra: that information is absent. Unexplained cases remain explicit while proved narrower sufficient bounds remain usable.
work_packages.deliverable: Fixed-population residual ledger and a separately versioned design-demand policy with actual consumer examples.

work_packages.title: Qualify independent section capacity and cage/detailing inputs
work_packages.environment: Offline independent numerical work; missing real drawings/report inputs may require source retrieval.
required_inputs: Actual bar coordinates, cover, materials and cage roles
Matched N and moment direction for C29 and one complete reference example
Strain/material laws and production section-method domain
procedure: Use an independent strip/fiber integration, axial root and radial geometry implementation; do not call the production capacity owner from the oracle.
Verify analytic limits, multiple relevant roots and spatial/angular convergence at fixed N and direction.
Test the actual selected cage, not a same-area surrogate.

Coordinate missing-source acquisition for the four goldens, but close only PMM_REPORT_GATE here. CAPACITY_SHEAR_REPORT_GATE belongs to S07; GOLDEN03/04 second-order report gates belong to S04/reference work. Preserve interpretation differences until adjudicated.
work_packages.independent_oracle: Independent numerical implementation and analytic limits; matched OpenSees fiber experiment may supplement but does not establish TS500 material acceptance.
acceptance: Prespecified capacity-unit tolerances are supported by residual and discretization estimates.
Section equilibrium and ray admissibility are checked at domain boundaries.
Shared constitutive assumptions are listed separately from implementation independence.
Minimum/detailing constraints and section resistance remain distinct checks.
work_packages.stop_or_branch: A rounded report match or a broad regression tolerance is not an independent PMM error bound. Expand beyond the current section domain only with its own evidence.
work_packages.deliverable: Independent capacity comparison table, complete cage input evidence and one qualified section-method domain.

work_packages.title: Complete standalone beam-column-joint capacity chain
work_packages.environment: Offline using complete source and detailing inputs; targeted native reads only as needed.
required_inputs: Complete incident beams and columns at a real joint
Actual beam longitudinal steel, anchorage, support faces and axial assumption
Signed compatible demands and selected cages
procedure: Compute actual signed end capacities and same-cut native Vd alongside capacity-derived Ve.
Run transverse reinforcement and joint-panel checks with actual geometry and confinement/anchorage facts.
Show a supported failure as well as a pass without losing incomplete neighbors.
Progress standalone members first; couple wall-frame capacity shear only after S03/S04 and the relevant wall design contract.
work_packages.independent_oracle: Independent beam/column capacity, shear and joint worksheets with exact incident-member census and source-linked clauses.
acceptance: All incident member endpoints are included or explicitly unresolved.
Brittle limits and known failures survive other missing checks.
No obsolete cage or first-order demand reaches final shear/joint consumers.
Final numbers reach the normal-runner sealed report.
work_packages.stop_or_branch: Beam N=0 and slab/anchorage contributions require an explicit applicable assumption; do not infer them from missing source fields.
work_packages.deliverable: One complete standalone column-beam-joint calculation chain, with supported scope and failure witnesses.

work_packages.title: Demonstrate nontrivial alpha feedback with real owners
work_packages.environment: Offline candidate preparation; native reanalysis only if the chosen revision invalidates source stiffness/geometry.
required_inputs: A complete real case with 0.70 <= alpha < 1
Candidate: strongcol4.docx story 1, Vk/Vs 45.813/41.607 and 54.035/41.450; capacities and generation still need binding
Original immutable demand, incident capacities and actual cages

A qualified second-order method for this benchmark with source/stiffness/applicability identity; use an applicable standalone method. Require the relevant S04 artifact only if the example enters its coupled or unresolved domain.
procedure: Compute alpha through real capacities; the report candidate gives about 0.908192 and 0.767095, not a preapproved new source.
Apply the prescribed demand transformation exactly once from the original demand, then rerun selection, PMM, Ve, ties and joints.
Record each iteration, source invalidation and convergence or exhaustion.
Keep alpha=1 and alpha<0.70 as separate control/system-boundary cases.
work_packages.independent_oracle: Independent joint/story force partition and end-capacity worksheet; visible before/after change in an actual downstream governing result.
acceptance: No injected successful-stage dictionaries.
At least one genuine downstream demand, utilization or cage decision changes.
Replaying the same source cannot compound the factor.
Nonconvergence and the alpha<0.70 structural-system consequence are reported explicitly.
work_packages.stop_or_branch: The original C29 zero-iteration outcome remains valid within its scope. If the report lacks capacities, acquire those exact fields or identify a separately named complete physical benchmark. Do not wait for the full C29 wall-frame method to verify an independently qualified standalone alpha example; do not bypass the chosen example's own second-order qualification.
work_packages.deliverable: Sealed before/after feedback example with all affected consumers and a transparent stopping reason.

work_packages.title: Align execution, required instances and sealed reporting
work_packages.environment: Offline architecture lane; coordinate module ownership with engineering work.
required_inputs: Actual runner sequence, 22 registry entries and candidate mapping
Current supported physical/family census
Recorded source/scenario/stage/report hashes
procedure: Expose R14 and hidden report-evidence checks in the registry without duplicating their calculation owners.
Validate current consumes/produces against actual execution and retain unresolved required instances.
Extract neutral frame topology from R10 with unchanged semantics and dedicated migration comparisons.
Define the scoped acceptance-result contract and keep finalized report generation a pure projection.
work_packages.independent_oracle: Recorded-run equivalence, deliberate missing/failing instance challenges, UI/CLI/report identity checks and source-to-result trace review.
acceptance: Registry claims match invoked owners and artifacts.
Every supported required instance has a terminal result/reason.
Identical source/method produces equivalent sealed stage payloads.
Neither node binding nor UI visibility is counted as engineering execution or approval.
work_packages.stop_or_branch: Do not introduce another 94-node runtime. Avoid changing geometry identities and engineering formulas in one patch.
work_packages.deliverable: Observable current execution graph, complete supported-instance ledger and source-compatible geometry ownership.

work_packages.title: Qualify and extend the supported frame design slice
work_packages.environment: Integrated offline/native replay under the declared source basis.
required_inputs: Qualified previous-sprint artifacts
All 87 original columns and every required case/check instance
Independent complete design example and scoped acceptance criteria
procedure: Complete one independently verified supported frame design before expanding the accepted domain.
Account for all 87 columns; distinguish 73 standalone and 14 coupled rather than converting a selected subset to a building result.
Expand only through qualified domain conditions and demonstrate UI/report/check-ledger agreement.
Use a scoped acceptance evaluator with evidence and review, not a hard-coded READY edit.
work_packages.independent_oracle: Complete independent design calculation using the same physical/source/cage identities.
acceptance: Supported scope is independently verified end to end.
All excluded/unsupported required members remain visible with reasons.
Fresh full regression results identify environment, commit, logs and skip reasons.
Whole-building acceptance remains unavailable while mandatory product families are absent.
work_packages.stop_or_branch: 73 proven lengths are not 73 accepted designs. A selected-column acceptance does not close full-building mandatory scope.
work_packages.deliverable: Reviewed supported-frame release candidate with complete instance accounting and independently checked numerical outputs.

work_packages.title: Deliver full wall/pier and coupling-beam design
work_packages.environment: New domain implementation in the existing package; construction and native source evidence required.
required_inputs: Actual wall/pier/coupling-beam reinforcement and physical sections
Qualified simultaneous or approved bounded demands
Boundary-region, confinement and applicable system rules
procedure: Create the missing wall domain owner within YENI, with explicit axial-flexural, shear, boundary, confinement and coupling-beam responsibilities.
Implement one real wall slice including geometry changes and adjoining column interaction.
Add complete expected instances, independent capacity checks and a sealed report section.
work_packages.independent_oracle: Independent complete wall/pier/coupling-beam calculation and physical reinforcement/detail review.
acceptance: Wall geometry screening is not relabeled wall design.
Critical regions and actual reinforcement continuity are included.
Brittle and ductile checks remain distinct with all required cases accounted.
work_packages.stop_or_branch: Do not apply the current symmetric rectangular-column PMM domain to arbitrary composite walls without qualification.
work_packages.deliverable: First complete verified wall/pier slice, then a documented domain-expansion plan.

work_packages.title: Complete diaphragm transfer and remaining building irregularities
work_packages.environment: Whole-building domain milestone; can proceed beside wall research.
required_inputs: Diaphragm constraints, openings, collectors/chords and transfer levels
Applicable A2/A3/B3 and other required building checks
Same-state floor/cut force and geometric evidence
procedure: Define missing physical diaphragm/load-path checks and their required instance population.
Implement one force-transfer example with collectors/chords and opening/transfer applicability.
Keep already implemented A1/B1/B2 scopes separate from missing irregularity rules.
work_packages.independent_oracle: Independent floor free body and clause-level geometry/applicability worksheet.
acceptance: Force transfer is checked, not inferred from a rigid-diaphragm assignment.
All applicable irregularity instances are classified with evidence.
work_packages.stop_or_branch: An existing UI/catalog row is not a calculation owner. Introduce missing owners through the common runner only.
work_packages.deliverable: Verified diaphragm/transfer slice and an explicit complete irregularity applicability matrix.

work_packages.title: Complete slab and beam serviceability/design families
work_packages.environment: Whole-building milestone with bounded sub-sprints for slab, punching and beam SLS/torsion.
required_inputs: Slab geometry/supports/openings, reinforcement and applicable load cases
Long-term cracking/creep assumptions and serviceability limits
Beam torsion, side reinforcement, anchorage and actual support conditions
procedure: Add missing slab flexure/punching/serviceability owners with actual physical sections.
Complete beam torsion/side reinforcement/anchorage and crack/deflection scopes as separate bounded cards.
Use stated long-term stiffness and load assumptions; preserve construction versus selected reinforcement roles.
work_packages.independent_oracle: Independent slab/punching and beam SLS/torsion calculations with analytical limits and matched physical examples.
acceptance: Each family reaches a normal-runner report and independent numerical comparison.
Instantaneous and long-term deflection/strength checks remain distinct.
Missing detailing and serviceability scope cannot vanish from building acceptance.
work_packages.stop_or_branch: Treat this as a milestone to decompose after the first physical example is selected, not a promise to implement an entire slab/beam code in one short sprint.
work_packages.deliverable: Verified first examples and domain-specific acceptance matrices for the missing horizontal-member families.

work_packages.title: Deliver foundation and ground-interface design
work_packages.environment: Whole-building milestone; geotechnical and construction inputs are essential.
required_inputs: Geotechnical design parameters and adopted combinations
Foundation geometry, contact/uplift conditions, reinforcement and supports
Qualified superstructure reactions and applicable soil-structure assumptions

Applicable qualified flexure, shear and punching methods; consume the specific S11/S13 artifacts only where the chosen foundation requires them, without waiting for unrelated wall or beam-SLS completion.
procedure: Implement ground pressure/contact/uplift and foundation flexure, punching and shear as explicit new domain owners.
Distinguish superstructure end restraint from foundation capacity and geotechnical acceptability.
Qualify one actual foundation example and then the supported foundation types.
work_packages.independent_oracle: Independent geotechnical/contact and reinforced-concrete foundation calculations, including equilibrium and limiting cases.
acceptance: Load combinations, contact domain and soil assumptions are explicit.
Foundation and soil failure modes have independent results.
Support qualification is never represented as completed foundation design.
work_packages.stop_or_branch: Start source/schema work in parallel; final acceptance needs qualified upstream reactions and domain methods. Missing geotechnical parameters cannot be inferred from ETABS labels.
work_packages.deliverable: First integrated foundation/soil-interface design slice and supported-domain statement.

work_packages.title: Independent whole-building acceptance and release
work_packages.environment: Controlled integration and independent engineering review.
required_inputs: Completed applicable domain owners and full required-instance census
Versioned accepted profile, methods and design/cage revisions
Independent building example and all material discrepancy decisions
procedure: Run a complete independently checkable building example through the common source-to-report route.
Reconcile physical source tree, rule applicability, dependency graph and result tree without disappearing required instances.
Implement and exercise the scoped acceptance evaluator and review workflow.
Freeze final source/method identities, full test logs, numerical differences and accepted limitations.
work_packages.independent_oracle: Independent complete structural calculation and review of source, methods, detailing and governing failure modes.
acceptance: Every required instance is covered or has an accepted applicability exclusion.
No unresolved mandatory numerical/source/method failure is hidden by a global flag.
UI, CLI, exported report and ledger agree on scope and status.
Release is a reviewed evidence result, not a test-count threshold.
work_packages.stop_or_branch: Do not advertise complete building READY before mandatory wall/slab/foundation/diaphragm and other applicable families are qualified.
work_packages.deliverable: Reviewed engineering release for an explicit building/product domain, with reproducible evidence and remaining exclusions.
